rationale: Config-driven default-list extension matches the only established pattern for adding single files to worktree copies (.claude/settings.local.json, .env); avoids Option B's leak of ll.local.md into the verify-only worktree that deliberately passes copy_files=[].
rule: Option A: extend default worktree_copy_files list to include .ll/ll.local.md
alternatives_rejected: Option B: unconditional copy inside setup_worktree alongside the .claude/ copytree — bypasses copy_files entirely and would leak into verify_epic_branch_before_merge's transient worktree
